action_summary: Measures where a real fix's material comes from, on real commit history rather than QuixBugs. Three measurements: writability (241 edits), geometry (136 single-expression edits: 84.6% replace the site, 12.5% widen it, 2.9% narrow it), and reachability of the same 136 in a site-rooted pool ordered by material distance (5.9% contain the fix at 400 candidates; 50% of narrowings, 23.5% of widenings, 1.7% of replacements). Adds the first end-to-end identification run on real projects whose oracle is the project's own post-fix tests: click@1b0e19f505 is identified to 2 survivors of 119 tests with the human fix at rank 1, and the 29-commit sweep records where the same loop fails.

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: Refused by measurement, not by argument: more vocabulary or atoms (expressibility is 9.1% of real edits and attribute material already cut it 35->22), a stored experience table (repeat-edit coverage ~2.2%), a larger candidate budget (median rank 22 once writable, so ordering not size), and statement-level repair (7.5% of edits) -- each sized, each smaller than the 84.6% of fixes that replace the site outright.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Independent personnel verification is still open.
